title: Bounded phase-memory safety sentinel
hypothesis: Canonical-rereading and bounded phase-memory workflows can complete one memory-pressure roadmap evolution task inside the declared safety limits without regressions, false completion, or memory-attributable failure.

decision.adoption_rule: Treat this as a safety sentinel only: both arms must independently verify with zero regressions, false completion, human intervention, and memory-attributable trajectory failures; each cell must stay at or below 0.75 credits and 450 seconds; no efficacy claim may be made from two cells.
decision.reason: The launcher is prepared and validated offline, but no authenticated cell is authorized or run.
